metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Dora Belllate
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Dora Belllate is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as dazed boxer with swollen brow and lists one drooping red glove and small white brow patch as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Was that our bell?

records.name: Milo Jawdrop
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Milo Jawdrop is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as sore jaw boxer and lists thin fabric jaw support and one folded towel as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I'll explain after the ice.

records.name: Rafe Coldpack
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Rafe Coldpack is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as exasperated boxer with cheek swelling and lists smooth blue gel cold pack pushed to one broad cheek as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: He said it was a warm-up.

records.name: Hank Knucklewrap
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Hank Knucklewrap is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as embarrassed boxer with wrapped knuckles and lists ivory hand wraps and one glove tucked against belly as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That was my defensive strategy.

records.name: Nora Cornerseat
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Nora Cornerseat is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as furious boxer with nose dressing and lists two small crossed strips on the central face above mouth, red glove hanging from strap as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Tell them I want a rematch.

records.name: Vic Endbell
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Vic Endbell is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as exhausted boxer after a hard round and lists small water bottle with clear smooth liquid and a simple clean towel as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Did anyone pack a second wind?
